segments.ja385:1.1: Sace brāhmaṇa gacchesi, sākete [sāketaṃ (sī. syā.)] ajjunaṃ [añjhanaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] vanaṃ;
segments.ja385:1.5: Mātā pitā ca te vuddhā, te taṃ icchanti passituṃ.
segments.ja385:2.3: Taṃ rājapiṇḍaṃ avabhottuṃ [avabhottaṃ (ka.)], nāhaṃ brāhmaṇa mussahe.
segments.ja385:3.1: Odahissāmahaṃ passaṃ, khurappānissa [khurappāṇissa (sī.), khurapāṇissa (pī.), khurappapāṇissa (?)] rājino;
segments.ja385:3.3: Tadāhaṃ sukhito mutto, api passeyya mātaraṃ.
segments.ja385:4.1: Migarājā pure āsiṃ, kosalassa niketane [niketave (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja385:5.1: Taṃ maṃ vadhitumāgacchi, dāyasmiṃ ajjune vane;
segments.ja385:5.3: Dhanuṃ ārajjaṃ [ārajjuṃ (niyya), adejjhaṃ (sī. pī.) advedhābhāvaṃ ekībhāvanti attho] katvāna, usuṃ sannayha [sandhāya (sī. pī.)] kosalo.
segments.ja385:9.1: Atha kujjharathesabha ketuvaro, sadarīmukha neru latā ca puna;
segments.ja385:9.3: Apananda sirī ca sucittavaro, atha dhammika nandimigena dasāti.
